rows.name_as_written: Cooperative Health Research in the Region of Augsburg (KORA) S4
rows.quote: The discovery sample was derived from the population-based KORA S4 cohort study comprising 4261 participants at baseline (1999 to 2001) [18].
rows.coder_note: Step 3, rules C2 and C: the outcome data are the authors' own incident-CHD analysis of the KORA S4 cohort, and the outcome side of the dictionary has no KORA row under any release (KORA is listed only on the pQTL side); no accession (C4 not applicable).

rows.quote: For validation, data from the KORA-Age1 study was used.
rows.coder_note: Step 3, rules C2 and C: the validation outcome data are the authors' own analysis of the KORA-Age1 study, a named study for which the outcome side of the dictionary has no row under any release; no accession (C4 not applicable).
